setting: The aliens are alive, ancient, and vetting humanity in real time. They lend a trickle of technology as worthiness-tests; each lent gift also encodes the location of a sealed cache of high-value technology. Humans triangulate caches from gifts, race rivals to reach them, and must prove worthy to open them — every find tightening or fraying a live relationship.

civs.name: the-irenni
civs.trait: ancient, patient gatekeepers who lend gifts as tests and read every human choice

civs.name: the-saalvane
civs.trait: a splinter that thinks humanity should be denied, not vetted — they sabotage the gifts

civs.name: the-mendicant-tier
civs.trait: a neutral caste that brokers access and adjudicates worthiness disputes
